module_1.en: Reflect on a time you witnessed or heard other men normalizing violence or abuse. What held you back from speaking up, and how would you handle it today?

module_2.en: What is the biggest pressure you have felt from society about 'what it means to be a real man'? How has that pressure affected your relationships or peace of mind?
module_2.pcm: Wetin be the biggest pressure wey society don put for your head about 'wetin e mean to be correct man'? How that pressure don affect your love life or your peace of mind?

module_3.en: If a friend, brother, or peer close to you was acting abusive toward a partner, what is the most honest, respectful way you could intervene without causing violence?

module_3.ha: Idan wani na kusa da kai—aboki, dan'uwa, ko tsara—yana cin zarafin abokin zamansa, menene hanya mafi gaskiya da girmamawa da za ka iya shiga tsakani ba tare da kawo rikici ba?
module_3.yo: Ti eniyan ti o sunmọ ọ—ọrẹ, arakunrin, tabi ẹlẹgbẹ—ba n lo nilokulo si alabaṣepọ rẹ, kini ọna to dara julọ lati da si lai fa ija?
module_3.ig: Ọ bụrụ na onye dị gị nso—enyi gị, nwanne gị, ma ọ bụ onye ọgbọ gị—na-emegbu onye ọzọ, kedu ụzọ kacha mma ị ga-esi tinye ọnụ n'emeghị ihe ike?

module_4.en: Think about your most recent disagreement. Did you prioritize winning and control, or did you prioritize understanding and consent? How can you practice active respect in your next conflict?
module_4.pcm: Think about your last argument or fight. You try to show power and win, or you try to understand and respect them? How you go take show respect next time argue burst?
module_4.ha: Yi tunani a kan sabani ko rikici na baya-bayan nan. Shin ka fi ba da fifiko ga yin nasara da iko, ko kuwa ka ba da fifiko ga fahimta da yarda? Yaya za ka nuna girmamawa a rikici na gaba?
module_4.yo: Ranti aiyedeegbọn tabi ija ti o kẹhin ti o ni. Ṣe o fun ni pataki lati bori ati ṣakoso, tabi o fun ni pataki lati loye ati gba? Bawo ni o ṣe le fi owo gidi han ni ija atẹle rẹ?
module_4.ig: Chee echiche banyere esemokwu gị kacha nso nso a. Ị nwetara mmeri na njikwa, ka ị nwetara nghọta na nkwenye? Kedu ka ị ga-esi gosi ugwu na esemokwu gị ọzọ?

module_5.en: Think of a time you witnessed something unfair — a degrading comment, disrespectful behaviour, or abuse — and you said nothing. What stopped you? What would you do if it happened tomorrow?
module_5.pcm: Think of one time wey you see something wey no pure—like bad comment, disrespect, or abuse—but you keep quiet. Wetin hold you make you no speak up? If e happen tomorrow, wetin you go do?
module_5.ha: Ka yi tunani a kan lokacin da ka ga wani abu da ba daidai ba—kamar kalamai na cin zarafi ko rashin girmamawa—kuma ba ka ce komai ba. Menene ya hana ka magana? Me za ka yi idan hakan ya faru gobe?
module_5.yo: Ranti igba kan ti o ri nkan ti ko tọ—oro ti ko dara, iwa aini-owo, tabi ilokulo—ti o si dakẹ. Kini o da ọ duro lati sọrọ? Kini o le ṣe ti o ba tun farahan lọla?
module_5.ig: Chee echiche banyere oge ị hụrụ ihe na-adịghị mma—kalamai mkparị, omume nkwutu, ma ọ bụ mmegbu—ma gbachi nkịtị. Gịnị gbochiri gị ikwu okwu? Gịnị ka ị ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na ọ mee echi?

module_6.en: Think about the most important relationship in your life right now. Do you communicate honestly? Do you listen well? Is there something you need to change?
module_6.pcm: Think about the most important relationship wey you get right now. You dey talk with truth and respect? You dey listen well? Show us wetin you feel say you need to change.
module_6.ha: Ka yi tunani game da mafi mahimmancin dangantaka a rayuwarka yanzu. Shin kuna magana cikin gaskiya? Kuna sauraro da kyau? Shin akwai abin da kake bukatar canjawa?
module_6.yo: Ronu nipa ibatan pataki julọ ninu igbesi aye rẹ lọwọlọwọ. Ṣe o n sọrọ pẹlu otitọ? Ṣe o n tẹtisi daradara? Nkan wo ni o nilo lati canjawa?
module_6.ig: Chee echiche banyere mmekọrịta kachasị mkpa na rayuwarka ugbu a. Ị na-ekwurịta okwu n'eziokwu? Ị na-ege ntị nke ọma? Ọ nwere ihe ị chọrọ ịgbanwe?

module_7.en: Think of someone in your life — a friend, a family member, a neighbour — who you suspect may be experiencing abuse. What has stopped you from saying something? What is one thing you could do this week?
module_7.pcm: Think of one person wey close to you—friend, family member, or neighbour—wey you suspect say person dey treat bad. Wetin hold you make you no talk? Mention one small step you fit take this week.
module_7.ha: Ka yi tunanin wani a rayuwarka—aboki, dan uwa, ko makwabci—wanda kake zargin ana cin zarafinsa. Menene ya hana ka cewa wani abu? Menene abu daya da zaka iya yi a wannan makon?
module_7.yo: Ronu nipa ẹnikan ninu igbesi aye rẹ—ọrẹ kan, mọlẹbi kan, tabi aladuugbo kan—ti o fura pe o n doju kọ ilokulo. Kini o da ọ duro lati sọrọ? Ohun kan wo ni o le ṣe ni ọsẹ yii?
module_7.ig: Chee echiche banyere onye dị gị nso—enyi, onye ezinụlọ, ma ọ bụ onye agbata obi—nke ị na-enyo enyo na ọ na-enweta mmegbu. Gịnị gbochiri gị ikwu okwu? Gịnị bụ otu ihe ị ga-eme n'izu a?

module_8.en: Think about the men you spend the most time with. How do they talk about women? How do you respond? What kind of influence are you having on them — and they on you?
module_8.pcm: Think about the men wey you dey spend time with pass. How they dey talk about women? Wetin you dey do when they dey talk? How you dey copy them, and how they dey copy you?
module_8.ha: Ka yi tunani game da mazan da kuke yawan zama tare da su. Yaya suke magana game da mata? Yaya kake amsawa? Wane irin tasiri kuke da shi a kansu—kuma su a kanku?
module_8.yo: Ronu nipa awọn ọkunrin ti o n lo akoko pọ julọ pẹlu wọn. Bawo ni wọn ṣe n sọrọ nipa awọn obinrin? Bawo ni o ṣe n fesi si wọn? Wọn ni ipa wo lori rẹ, iwọ na si ni ipa wo lori wọn?
module_8.ig: Chee echiche banyere ndị ikom gị na ha na-anọkarị. Kedu ka ha si ekwu maka ụmụ nwanyị? Kedu ka ị si aza? Kedu ụdị mmetụta ị na-enwe n'ahụ ha—na ha n'ahụ gị?

module_9.en: Think about your community — your street, your church or mosque, your age group, your market. What is one conversation about GBV or gender norms that needs to happen there? Who could you have it with this week?
module_9.pcm: Think about your community—your street, church or mosque, age group, or park. Which talk about SGBV or gender rules suppose happen there? Who you fit talk this thing with this week?
module_9.ha: Ka yi tunani game da al'ummarku—titinku, coci ko masallaci, rukunin shekarunku, ko kasuwarku. Wace tattaunawa ce game da GBV ko dabi'un jinsi da ya kamata a yi a can? Da wa za ku iya tattaunawa a wannan makon?
module_9.yo: Ronu nipa alagbegbe rẹ—opopona rẹ, ṣọọṣi tabi mọṣalasi rẹ, egbe ọjọ rẹ, tabi ọja rẹ. Ibaraẹnisọrọ wo nipa GBV tabi igbagbo eya ti o yẹ ki o waye ni bẹ? Tani o le ba sọrọ ni ọsẹ yii?
module_9.ig: Chee echiche banyere obodo gị—okporo ụzọ gị, ụlọ ụka ma ọ bụ alakuba gị, ndị ọgbọ gị, ma ọ bụ ahịa gị. Kedu nkata banyere GBV ma ọ bụ omenala nwoke na nwanyị kwesịrị ime ebe ahụ? Ònye ka ị ga-aba na nkata n'izu a?

module_10.en: Who are three men in your life who you could invite into this work? Not perfect men. Men who are ready to grow. What would you say to them?

module_10.ha: Su wane ne maza uku a rayuwarka da za ka iya gayyata don shiga wannan aikin? Ba maza marasa aibu ba. Maza da suke a shirye su girma. Me za ka ce musu?
module_10.yo: Awọn ọkunrin mẹta wo ninu igbesi aye rẹ ni o le pe lati darapọ mọ iṣẹ yii? Kii ṣe eniyan ti ko ni abawọn, ṣugbọn awọn ti o ṣetan lati dagba. Kini iwọ yoo sọ fun wọn?
module_10.ig: Ònye bụ ndị ikom atọ n'obodo gị ị ga-akpọ ka ha sonye n'ọrụ a? Ọ bụghị ndị ikom na-enweghị ntụpọ, kama ndị dị njikere itolite. Gịnị ka ị ga-agwa ha?

module_11.en: Did you know that domestic violence and SGBV are criminal offenses in Nigeria, not private family matters? How does this change the way you view intervention?

module_11.ha: Shin kun san cewa cin zarafin gida da SGBV laifuka ne na manyan laifuka a Najeriya, ba batutuwan sirri na iyali ba? Yaya wannan ya canza yadda kuke kallon shiga tsakani?
module_11.yo: Ṣe o mọ pe iwa-ipa ile ati SGBV jẹ ẹṣẹ ọdaràn labẹ ofin orilẹ-ede Naijiria, kii ṣe ọrọ ikọkọ ti ẹbi? Bawo ni eyi ṣe yi ọna ti o fi n wo idasi si?
module_11.ig: Ị maara na ime ihe ike n'ezinụlọ na SGBV bụ mpụ dị njọ n'okpuru iwu Naịjirịa, ọ bụghị ihe nzuzo ezinụlọ? Kedu ka nke a si gbanwee otú ị si ele itinye ọnụ anya?

module_12.en: Six weeks ago, you started this course. Think about who you were then. What has changed in how you think? What has changed in how you act? What do you still want to work on?
module_12.pcm: Six weeks ago, you start this course. Think about who you be that time. Wetin don change for how you dey think? Wetin don change for how you dey act? Wetin you still want work on?

module_12.yo: Oṣe mẹfa sẹhin, o bẹrẹ eko yii. Ronu nipa ẹni ti o jẹ ni igba yẹn. Kini o ti yipada ninu bi o ṣe n ronu? Kini o ti yipada ninu bi o ṣe n ṣe? Kini o tun fẹ lati ṣiṣẹ lori rẹ?
module_12.ig: Izu isii gara aga, ị malitere akwụkwọ a. Chee echiche banyere onye ị bụ mgbe ahụ. Gịnị gbanwere n'otú ị si eche echiche? Gịnị gbanwere n'otú ị si emeso ihe? Gịnị ka ị ka na-achọ ịrụ ọrụ na ya?

module_1.en: You were born male. Being a man was taught to you. And anything that was taught can be learned differently.
module_1.pcm: Na male dem born you. But how to be man na wetin dem teach you. And anything wey dem teach person, he fit learn am another way.
module_1.ha: An haife ka a matsayin namiji. Amma an koya maka yadda ake zama namiji. Kuma duk abin da aka koya za a iya sake koyonsa ta wata hanyar.
module_1.yo: A bi ọ ni ọkunrin. Wọn kọ ọ bi o ṣe le jẹ ọkunrin. Ati ohunkohun ti a ba kọ ni a le kọ ni ọna miiran.
module_1.ig: A mụrụ gị dị ka nwoke. Mana a kụziiri gị otu esi abụ nwoke. Kandi ihe ọ bụla a kụziiri gị, a pụrụ ịmụta ya n'ụzọ ọzọ.

module_2.en: Toxic masculinity does not make you more of a man. It makes you less of a human.
module_2.pcm: Toxic masculinity no dey make you more of a man. E dey make you less of a human being.
module_2.ha: Halayen mazantaka na cutarwa ba sa sa ka zama cikakken namiji. Suna rage maka mutuntaka ne kawai.
module_2.yo: Iwa ọkunrin ti ko daa ko sọ ọ di ọkunrin gidi. O n dinku rẹ bi eniyan.
module_2.ig: Omume nwoke na-adịghị mma anaghị eme ka ị bụrụ nwoke karị. Ọ na-eme ka ị ghara ịbụ ezigbo mmadụ.

module_3.en: SGBV is not a woman's problem. It is a human problem. And it will take human beings — especially men — to end it.
module_3.pcm: SGBV no be only women problem. Na human problem. Kuma e go need human beings—especially men—to stop am.
module_3.ha: Rikicin jinsi ba matsalar mata ce kadai ba. Matsalar bil'adama ce. Kuma yana bukatar mutane—musamman maza—don kawo karshenta.
module_3.yo: Iwa-ipa jọmọ ẹya kii ṣe iṣoro obinrin nikan. Iṣoro eniyan ni. Yio si gba eniyan—paapaa awọn ọkunrin—lati fi opin si i.
module_3.ig: Mmegbu nwoke na nwanyị abụghị naanị nsogbu ụmụ nwanyị. Ọ bụ nsogbu mmadụ nile. Ọ ga-ewe kwa mmadụ—karịsịa ndị ikom—iji kwụsị ya.

module_4.en: Violence is not caused by anger. It is caused by the belief that one person has power over another.
module_4.pcm: No be vex dey cause violence. Na when person believe say he get power pass another person.
module_4.ha: Ba fushi ne ke kawo rikici ba. Yardar da mutum yake da ita cewa yana da iko a kan wani ne ke kawowa.
module_4.yo: Kii ṣe ibinu lo n fa iwa-ipa. O n waye nitori igbagbo pe eniyan kan ni agbara lori ẹlomiiran.
module_4.ig: Ọ bụghị iwe na-ebute ime ihe ike. Ọ bụ n'ihi nkwenye na otu onye nwere ikike n'elu onye ọzọ.

module_5.en: Being a good man is not enough. We need men who are actively good — who speak, act, and stand up even when it's uncomfortable.
module_5.pcm: To just be good man no do. We need men wey dey do good things—wey dey speak out, dey act, and dey stand up even when e hard.
module_5.ha: Zama mutumin kirki kadai bai wadatar ba. Muna bukatar maza masu fafutukar alheri—wadanda ke magana, aiki, da tsayawa ko da a lokatim wahala.
module_5.yo: Lati jẹ ọkunrin rere kọ to. A nilo awọn ọkunrin ti nṣe rere ni gbangba—ti wọn n sọrọ, n ṣe nkan, ti wọn si n dide duro paapaa nigbati ko rọrun.
module_5.ig: Ịbụ ezigbo nwoke ezughị. Anyị chọrọ ndị ikom na-eme ezigbo ihe—ndị na-ekwu okwu, na-eme ihe, ma na-eguzo ọtọ ọbụlagodi mgbe ọ na-adịghị mfe.

module_6.en: Respect is not weakness. It is the foundation of every strong relationship.
module_6.pcm: Respect no be weakness. Na the foundation wey strong relationship stand on.
module_6.ha: Girmamawa ba rauni ba ne. Shi ne harsashin kowace kyakkyawar dangantaka.
module_6.yo: Ọwọ kii ṣe ailera. O jẹ ipilẹ ti gbogbo ibatan to lagbara.
module_6.ig: Nkwanye ùgwù abụghị adịghị ike. Ọ bụ ntọala nke mmekọrịta ọ bụla siri ike.

module_7.en: Silence is not safety. Your voice, your action — however small — can save a life.
module_7.pcm: To keep quiet no mean say you dey safe. Your voice and your action—no matter how e small—fit save life.
module_7.ha: Yin shiru ba aminci ba ne. Muryarka, aikinka—ko da kankane ne—na iya ceton rai.
module_7.yo: Idakẹjẹ kii ṣe aabo. Ohun rẹ, iṣe rẹ—bi o ti wu ki o kere to—le gba ẹmi là.
module_7.ig: Ịgbachi nkịtị abụghị nchekwa. Olu gị, omume gị—ọ bụrụgodị na ọ dị obere—nwere ike ịzọpụta ndụ.

module_8.en: Your friends follow your lead more than you know. Lead well.
module_8.pcm: Your friends dey follow your hand pass wetin you think. Lead them well.
module_8.ha: Abokanka suna bin jagorancinka fiye da yadda kake tsammani. Jagoranci da kyau.
module_8.yo: Awọn ọrẹ rẹ n tẹle igbesẹ rẹ ju bi o ti mọ lọ. Rìn ọna rere.
module_8.ig: Ndị enyi gị na-agbaso ụzọ gị karịa ka ị maara. Duga ha nke ọma.

module_9.en: Change does not start in government. It starts in your compound, your mosque, your church, your friend group.
module_9.pcm: Change no dey start from government. E dey start from your compound, your mosque, your church, and among your friends.
module_9.ha: Canji ba ya farawa daga gwamnati. Yana farawa ne daga cikin gidanku, masallacinku, cocinku, da rukunin abokanku.
module_9.yo: Iyipada kii bẹrẹ lati ọdọ ijọba. O n bẹrẹ lati agbala rẹ, mọṣalasi rẹ, ṣọọṣi rẹ, ati ẹgbẹ ọrẹ rẹ.
module_9.ig: Mgbanwe anaghị amalite n'aka gọọmentị. Ọ na-amalite n'ogige gị, n'ụlọ alakuba gị, n'ụlọ ụka gị, na n'etiti ndị enyi gị.

module_10.en: Alone you walk fast. Together you walk far.
module_10.pcm: If you waka alone, you go run fast. But if we waka together, we go waka go far.
module_10.ha: Kai kadai za ka iya tafiya da sauri. Amma tare za mu iya tafiya mai nisa.
module_10.yo: Nikan o le rin yara. Ṣugbọn papọ a le rin jinna.
module_10.ig: Naanị gị, ị ga-aga ọsọ ọsọ. Mana anyị nọ n'otu, anyị ga-aga ebe dị anya.

module_11.en: Justice is not a favor. It is a right. Protect the vulnerable, know the law, and speak up for justice.
module_11.pcm: Justice no be favor. Na right. Protect those wey no get power, know the law, and speak up for justice.
module_11.ha: Shari'a ba alfarma ba ce. Hakki ne. Kare marasa karfi, san doka, kuma yi magana don tabbatar da adalci.
module_11.yo: Idajọ kii ṣe oore-ọfẹ. Ẹtọ ni. Dabobo awọn alailagbara, mọ ofin, ki o si sọrọ fun idajọ.
module_11.ig: Ikpe nkwụmọtọ abụghị amara. Ọ bụ ikike. Chebe ndị na-enweghị enyemaka, mara iwu, ma kwuo okwu maka ikpe nkwụmọtọ.

module_12.en: The course ends today. The work begins tomorrow. And it begins with you.
module_12.pcm: The course don end today. But the work dey start tomorrow. And e dey start with you.
module_12.ha: Darasin ya kare yau. Aikin yana farawa gobe. Kuma yana farawa ne da kai.
module_12.yo: Eko yii pari loni. Iṣẹ n bẹrẹ lọla. Ati pe o bẹrẹ pẹlu rẹ.
module_12.ig: Akwụkwọ a agwụla taa. Ọrụ a na-amalite echi. Ọ na-amalitekwa n'ahụ gị.

Muna girmama sirrin ku. Sai dai, ba tare da adana sunanku, imel, da jiha ba, ba za mu iya bin diddigin ci gaban ku ko samar da takardar shaidar ku ba.

Idan kun canza shawara kuma kuna son yin rajista, danna maballin da ke ƙasa don sake farawa.
consent_declined.yo:
❌ *Iforukọsilẹ Duro*

A bọwọ fun aṣiri rẹ. Sibẹisẹ, laisi fifipamọ orukọ rẹ, imeeli, ati ipinlẹ rẹ, a ko le tọju itẹsiwaju rẹ tabi ṣẹda iwe-ẹri ipari rẹ.

Ti o ba yi ipinnu rẹ pada ti o fẹ forukọsilẹ, tẹ bọtini ti o wa ni isalẹ lati bẹrẹ lẹẹkansi.
consent_declined.ig:
❌ *A Kwụsịrị Ndebanye aha*

Anyị na-akwanyere nzuzo gị ùgwù. Agbanyeghị, na-enweghị nchekwa aha gị, ozi-e gị na steeti gị, anyị enweghị ike soro ọganihu gị ma ọ bụ mepụta asambodo gị.

Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee obi gị ma chọọ idebanye aha, kpachapụ bọtini dị n'okpuru ebe a ka ịmalite ọzọ.

Wannan darasi an tsara shi ne musamman ga samari don yin tunani, tattauna kyakkyawar dabi'ar namiji, da kuma rigakafin cin zarafi na jinsi (GBV).

female_caveat.en:
❌ *Access Restricted*

Thank you for your interest! However, *The Brothers' Room* is designed specifically as a safe, reflective space for young men to discuss positive masculinity, accountability, and the prevention of Gender-Based Violence (GBV).

Because of this focus, access is restricted to male participants. We appreciate your understanding!
female_caveat.pcm:
❌ *No Access*

Thank you as you want register! But *The Brothers' Room* dey design specially as a safe and reflective space for young men to talk positive masculinity, accountability, and how we fit stop Gender-Based Violence (GBV).

Because of this, only male fit access the course. Thank you for your understanding!
female_caveat.ha:
❌ *An Hani Shiga*

Mungode da sha'awar ku! Sai dai, *The Brothers' Room* an tsara shi ne musamman a matsayin amintaccen fili don samari su tattauna kyakkyawar dabi'ar namiji, riƙe amana, da rigakafin cin zarafi na jinsi (GBV).

Saboda wannan dalili, shiga kwas ɗin ya takaita ga maza kawai. Muna godiya da fahimtar ku!
female_caveat.yo:
❌ *Ko le Wọle*

O ṣeun fun ifẹ rẹ! Sibẹsibẹ, *The Brothers' Room* jẹ apẹrẹ pataki fun awọn ọdọ ọkunrin lati sọrọ nipa okunrin rere, gbigba ẹbi, ati dena Ijagba lori Eya (GBV).

Nitori eyi, awọn ọkunrin nikan ni o le wo ẹkọ yii. A dupẹ fun oye rẹ!
female_caveat.ig:
❌ *A Machibidoro Nnweta*

Daaalụ maka mmasị gị! Agbanyeghị, *The Brothers' Room* bụ nke emere karịsịa maka ụmụ nwoke na-eto eto iji tụgharịa uche ma kwurịta gbasara ezi omume nwoke na igbochi ime ihe ike dabere na nwoke na nwanyị (GBV).

N'ihi nke a, ọ bụ naanị ụmụ nwoke nwere ike ịbanye na ya. Anyị na-ekele gị maka nghọta gị!
